snippet.title: InterSection Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Your world is dying.
Your predecessor gave his life to link you to a young world; now you must use this link to save your people.
This is InterSection.

For more info, contact me on Twitter @NarVWal, my email tallnarwal@narwalengineering.com or visit my website narwalengineering.com
